# The HTTP API's transcripts on the golden board basic: one request a
# line, "METHOD path [JSON body]", run in this order on one checkout, so
# a write's effect shows in the reads after it. internal/server's
# TestAPITranscripts records each answer in NN-<slug>.txt (make golden)
# and checks v1 gives it again. <newN> is the Nth hash the board didn't
# hold, as the answers before it name it (a written pack, its commit):
# the request takes the same hash. The normalisations are listed in
# docs/rewrite/compat.md, Normalisations.
GET /api/issues
GET /api/issues?filter=is:open,closed
GET /api/issues?filter=status:in-progress%20prio:p0
GET /api/issues?filter=%22unless%20the%20query%22
GET /api/issues?filter=is:closed&group=status
GET /api/facets?filter=is:open
GET /api/facets?filter=assignee:chloe
GET /api/issues/26a4ba85e9ef4a8ff1b61f228dd598c8b3667905
GET /api/issues/26a4ba8/thread
GET /api/issues/9062b9a381ed0075abb7c2b22261a9be88f7a685/thread
GET /api/issues/999eab2e4a22d1af3d62abffe7e62e79db7d12ac/thread
